summary: xAI released Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0, an updated speech-to-speech voice model with improved reasoning, transcription accuracy and latency, set to replace the prior version as the default on August 5, 2026, priced at $0.08 per minute of audio.

mechanisms.reason: The model is stated to use substantially fewer reasoning tokens per response than its predecessor for the same task, reducing compute per response.
mechanisms.quote: Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0 has been trained to be very efficient with reasoning tokens relative to its predecessor.

practices.reason: An engineering team building voice agents on Grok gets a released model with stated gains in speech reasoning, time-to-first-audio, and tool-use benchmarks with no prompt changes required.
practices.quote: Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0 is our most intelligent voice model yet, building on its predecessor with meaningful gains in speech reasoning, conversational ability, and tool use reliability.

practices.reason: The release names specific public benchmarks (Big Bench Audio, Full Duplex Bench, τ-voice Bench, WER across 24 languages) that a team could run to compare voice models.
practices.quote: Speech-to-speech benchmark comparison between Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0 and competing models, per Artificial Analysis.

practices.reason: The reasoning-token efficiency gain is real and stated but is a lab-internal training technique, not something an integrating team can apply to their own serving stack.
practices.quote: Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0 0.4 × Grok Voice Think Fast 1.0 1.0 ×

practices.reason: The default alias will switch models on a fixed date, requiring teams that want to stay on the old version to pin it explicitly.
practices.quote: On August 5, 2026, grok-voice-latest will move from grok-voice-think-fast-1.0 to grok-voice-think-fast-2.0 . No action needed to upgrade. To stay on Grok Voice Think Fast 1.0, pin grok-voice-think-fast-1.0 before then.
